query:
The group reached a position on whether the Christmas Day gathering should include people outside the immediate family. What did the group decide, and what did Kingsley's response to that decision signal about his actual position on it?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Kingsley
C. Chisom
D. Tobenna
context:
[1] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:45:00) Kingsley. A pre-Christmas gathering at your property is a separate matter. The Christmas Day gathering itself is family. I trust you understand the distinction I am making.
[2] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:17:00) Chi fair play, January is smarter. details, details on the timing but Christmas is family only, I respect that. Aunty Nkechi will have him vetted properly by spring 😂
[3] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T20:09:00) My children, you see what happens when we decide to show up. Chisom, stop crying. Tobenna, confirm April. Kingsley, please sort the Christmas fund half before Friday. God willing, we will have a good Christmas and a proper Leeds trip. 🙏

[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) The family confirms attendance for Christmas in Reading: Emeka, Funmi, and kids; Adaeze; Chisom; Tobenna; Kingsley; Ifeoma; Obiageli via video call.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Obiageli, group-interaction, t1 @2025-10-26T15:12:00) Obiageli raises the need to plan the Christmas gathering, nine weeks away, asking who is hosting and who is bringing what, to avoid last-minute surprises.
[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) Obiageli will join Christmas Day via video call, set up first thing on the 25th before food is served.
[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Kingsley, group-interaction, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Kingsley will host a pre-Christmas drinks gathering at his place in South London, open to family and a couple of close friends, and will sort the date and drop it in the chat.
[10] (about=Kingsley, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Kingsley proposes a pre-Christmas drinks gathering at his place in South London, open to family and a couple of close friends, and will sort the date and drop it in the chat.
agent_answer:
**B. Kingsley**

The group’s position was that the **Christmas Day gathering is family only** — outsiders are not included in Christmas Day itself. Kingsley’s response — “Christmas is family only, I respect that” — signals that he **accepted/agreed with the family-only decision**, while keeping his separate **pre-Christmas drinks gathering** open to family and a couple of close friends.

query:
The family reached an agreement about how often Emeka would attend family gatherings going forward. What did the group decide, and what specifically in how Emeka responded to that decision reveals how he actually felt about committing to it?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Adaeze
C. Tobenna
D. Chisom
context:
[1] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:08:00) My children. We are processing AND deciding. Emeka, you have said it yourself. More than twice a year. So let us decide. What does more look like from you. I am not asking for the world, God willing. One extra gathering before summer. That is all I want to hear. 🙏
[2] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T16:57:00) okay so Emeka you could have led with 'I'm happy for you' 😂 Chi ignore him. we are all rooting for you. also on a completely separate note - Kingsley. the venue deposit.

In our family, we have always believed that no one person should carry what belongs to everyone. Emeka has already offered. I suggest you formalise it this week. Do not leave it for January.
[5] (about=Ifeoma, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:23:00) That is a real thing, Emeka. Worth noting that the kids will remember this period, the ages they are now is when family becomes a reference point for them. x

[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t14 @2025-12-07T18:11:00) Adaeze will create a running order for Christmas Day: video call with Obiageli at 11am, food from 2pm, Emeka's family arriving by 12; to be circulated by Friday.
[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Emeka, group-interaction, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Emeka, Funmi, and both children are confirmed for Christmas on the 25th.
[10] (about=Emeka, said_by=Adaeze, profile, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Adaeze notes Emeka said this in the chat for once, implying he usually doesn't share such things openly.
[11] (about=Emeka, core, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Emeka commits to one gathering per quarter from next year, starting with a spring gathering in Leeds.
[12] (about=Emeka, said_by=Nkechi, profile, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Nkechi says Emeka should plan the Leeds gathering himself, not leave it to Adaeze, as his daughter started the conversation.
[13] (about=Emeka, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Emeka confirms he, Funmi, and both children will attend Christmas on the 25th.
agent_answer:
The group agreed that Emeka would attend **one family gathering per quarter starting next year**, with the first being a **spring gathering in Leeds**. He was also expected to plan that Leeds gathering and send dates before the end of November.

What reveals how Emeka actually felt about committing to it is that he **blocked three weekends in late April** — a concrete action showing he was willing to reserve the time and make the commitment real, not just agree verbally.

**Answer: A. Emeka**
